name: Air pollution risk reduction
summary: A very high-burden global risk area where useful software work is likely to sit in monitoring, exposure data, forecasting, policy analysis, and public-health operations rather than a single obvious upstream application.

metrics.claim: GBD 2021 reported particulate matter air pollution as the leading analyzed risk factor for global disease burden in 2021, contributing 8.0% of total DALYs with uncertainty intervals.
WHO's 2024 Global Health Estimates page notes that the latest release covers mortality, morbidity, and burden trends for more than 160 diseases and injuries through 2021.

software_pathways.claim: Likely OSS pathways include air-quality data pipelines, exposure models, sensor QA, alerting, and public dashboards; project discovery must verify active maintainers and a concrete issue before any contribution.
